This '''underwater civilization''' once inhabited the floor of the [[Crescent Sea]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. It was long-dead by the [[Time/Legends|time]] its ruins were discovered during a period of severe droughts on Agamar around ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Secrets of the Deep}}</ref>
